# Nanoshield Cambodia

> Nanoshield Cambodia applies patented Nanotube ceramic coating (paint protection system, "PPS") to cars in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. The coating is rated 10H on the pencil hardness test (certified by SGS), is imported from the UK, and protects paint for up to 7 years.

- Location: Chamkadong branch, #02A, Street 217, Sangkat Dangkor, Khan Dangkor, Phnom Penh (Chamkadong Road)
- Phone: +855 76 2222 188 (076 2222 188)
- Telegram: @NanoshieldCeramic (https://t.me/NanoshieldCeramic)
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEmM1kXBukdYmPY46
- Languages: English (/en) and Khmer (/km)

## Key facts

- Nanotube coating reaches 10H hardness; graphene coatings reach 9H.
- Benefits: gloss enhancement, scratch resistance, water repellency, acid-rain and UV protection, bird-dropping protection.
- Application: inspect, wash and decontaminate, polish, coat, cure and hand over.
- A coating does not fill deep scratches; those need paint repair before coating.
